face.name: 光明之翼
face.text: 战吼：随机将一张传说随从牌置入你的 手牌。
face.flavorText: 小精灵龙一般是由糖、香料和无数个疯狂的副作用所组成的。

face.name: Brightwing
face.text: Battlecry: Add a random Legendary minion to your hand.
face.flavorText: Little faerie dragons are made of sugar and spice and maniacal vice.

face.name: 斯尼德的伐木机
face.text: 亡语：随机召唤一个传说随从。
face.flavorText: 当斯尼德在死亡矿井被击败后，他的伐木机在一次拍卖中被一位匿名买家收购。（可能是霍格。）

face.name: Sneed's Old Shredder
face.flavorText: When Sneed was defeated in the Deadmines, his shredder was sold at auction to an anonymous buyer. (Probably Hogger.)

face.name: 德纳修斯大帝
face.text: 吸血，战吼：对所有敌人造成总计5点伤害。无限注能（ ）：伤害增加1点。
face.flavorText: 历史可以帮助人们避免走上反派的老路。不幸的是，温西尔个个都和大帝差不多。

face.name: Sire Denathrius
face.text: Lifesteal. Battlecry: Deal 5 damage amongst enemies. Endlessly Infuse ( ): Deal 1 more.
face.flavorText: History has a way of altering villains so that we can no longer see ourselves in them. Unfortunately for the Venthyr, they all look like Sire Denathrius.

face.name: 具象炉石
face.text: 战吼：打开一包标准卡牌包，使用其中的所有卡牌。
face.flavorText: 下面向您隆重介绍——移动版炉石！

face.name: Avatar of Hearthstone
face.text: Battlecry: Open a Standard Pack. Play all cards from it.

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

face.name: 恋旧风潮
face.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
face.flavorText: 风潮不改旧传说，相看恍如昨。

face.name: Wave of Nostalgia
face.text: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.
face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????

Gallery blank is display only, not evidence for period2 or damage values.
policies.pack: New original StandardPackProfile changes only source_card_id; original-source wrapper passes actual SourceAllocationFact and original profile ID to OpenStandardPack. Reuses unchanged complete independent current host pack domain, weights, ordered five occurrences and native playback.

uncertainties: Existing current-host pool eligibility/weights, native generation exclusion, actual death slot, Infuse preservation and pack-controller/native playback remain explicit local policies where CN-unverified.
